description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeEducationAPI class, a REST API endpoint handling CRUD operations for employee education records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting employee education data, along with validation rules, Swagger OpenAPI annotations for documentation, and dependency handling with a service layer.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing employee education data, providing CRUD operations with validation and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmployeeEducationService instance used for business logic operations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single employee education record by employee number and education ID, returning a resource result with the data.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all education records for a given employee with support for filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new employee education record based on provided parameters and associates it with the specified employee.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing employee education record identified by employee number and education ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes one or more employee education records based on provided IDs for the specified employee.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Populates and saves an EmployeeEducation entity with data from request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne operation, ensuring required path parameters are valid.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing records with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for creating a new employee education record, enforcing required fields.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating an existing education record, ensuring required identifiers are present.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting records, requiring employee number and array of IDs.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to define validation rules for optional, date, and numerical fields in create/update operations.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and record ID from request URL attributes.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for employee number parameter, checking access permissions.
